_meta.methodology: Reviewed metadata recovery from current official operator location pages, schedules, public operator-owned booking widgets, and official status documents. Fixed hours are recorded only when explicitly published; class-, appointment-, presale-, or otherwise restricted access is represented with explicit schedule semantics. No accounts, forms, authentication, or personal data were used.
